notes.title: Update 0.0.8
notes.notes: [h3]⚔️ Weapons & Ammo[/h3][list][*][p]Added new item — [b]Homemade Shotgun[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced damage for all weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]shotgun ammo[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠 Crafting & Resources[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]plant system[/b] (some plants in the world are now collectible).[/p][/*][*][p]Added new building — [b]Mixing Table[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced the first [b]crafting recipes[/b] at the Mixing Table.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧟 Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted zombie spawns.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎮 UI & Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Changed [b]inventory slot color[/b] to black with a white outline.[/p][/*][*][p]Added descriptions for inventory items that were missing them (food, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Discord link in the game menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed text color for loot notifications.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced minimap size.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]📢 Attention[/h2][p]🔹 [b]If you have a save file from version 0.0.6[/b] — you need to start a [b]new game[/b] and create a [b]new save[/b], because loot spawns in the world will be broken.[/p][p]🔹 [b]If your save was created in version 0.0.7[/b] — you don’t need to do anything, the game will work correctly.[/p]
